reviews.title: Disappointing experience
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this company and would not recommend them.

The software itself has been unreliable. It frequently lags, and one of the main reasons for buying a kids’ smartwatch—being able to see your child’s live location—doesn’t work properly most of the time. The previous watch we had from them also used to ring randomly for no apparent reason.

On top of these technical problems, I returned the watch in good condition, but the company later charged me claiming that it was broken. To the best of my knowledge, there was no damage to the watch when I packaged and returned it.

Overall, I’m very unhappy with both the product quality and the way the return was handled. Based on my experience, I would be very cautious about buying from this company.

reviews.title: Bring back Satellite map view!!!
reviews.text:
Please change the map view back to satellite! I really dislike the new map. It makes it much harder to precisely see where my child is, which is one of the main reasons I have the watch. I want him to have some independence in public spaces while still being able to see his exact location. The satellite view made that so much easier. 

I also have a red notification indicator that will not go away even when there are no new notifications. The only way I can clear it is by deleting and reinstalling the app, which is really annoying. 

Please bring back the satellite map view and fix the notification issue!

reviews.title: Doesn’t support iPad
reviews.text:
I was fooled. I bought into these glowing reviews. I bought a yearly subscription and the $50 sync module only to find after HOURS of fiddling with our iPads and never getting it to sync that they are having “issues with getting it to connect with iPads…” and instead of being transparent from the get go - I was told either I could get a refund or work with their engineers to “figure it out.” NO THANKS. 
So if you have an issue, there’s no phone number to call, you only have an AI bot that is slow and freezes when it eventually lets you to a human - I had to keep my phone in front of hoping to catch someone as it literally takes 10+ mins for a reply up to hours later, which then times out. 
If you email support they don’t listen / read and pass you along to other support and you start from square one. 
When used Bark without Sync (monitors some things sans sync) - my kids complained of their tablet being slow since it’s via VPN - it monitored Roblox and slow it down/freeze. It also would block odd things on the tablet so I spent a lot of time fiddling with it. It monitors YouTube which thought nearly every video was somehow inappropriate - but when I watched it, it wasn’t, for instance it dinged a cartoon dancing as possible sexual? It’s like an overzealous granny is monitoring it. First red flag was how much time I spent messing with all the settings just to give some freedom and noticing how the iPad slowed down. With the GARBAGE customer service that’s hard to get a hold of, a tricky system that over watches your kid like a criminal and overall non-transparent in knowingly sending and selling me something that doesn’t work on iPad it was a HUGE waste of time. I got refunded thankfully. Let this serve as a warning dear iPad users and to save time/frustration: DO NOT BUY or USE this service.
